carBox / wheels: measured on a 10x ruler crop of the pack photo. The detector put the rear wheel on the rim only (r 16) and the front one 4 px high; tyres are r 22.5, rear centred (110.5, 522), front (278, 518.5) - the car sits slightly nose-down in the blister

mask.remove (photo px, 8x ruler crop): between the wheels the segmenter took 1-2 px of the grey shadow line under the sill (to y 531); the cyan rocker ends at y ~529, so rows 530+ between the tyres (x 134-256) are cut

model.rebake.glass: every view traced on the mesh (ruler crops of tripo-sheet/tripo-clay). The aligned sheet masks spilled onto the door-window frames, roof rail and A/C pillars. Tripo left the door windows as open holes (nothing to paint) and modelled the quarter windows as panels: side/left trace the quarter-window panel inside its black frame. front: windscreen inside the black frit, stopping above the hood bulge; rear: the hatch glass Tripo painted below the roof lip; top: windscreen and hatch glass as Tripo modelled them (the drawing's rear window sits ~50 px further back, over the mesh's lower hatch panel). front/rear/top traced on one half and mirrored

model.rebake.skip top x 118-187: the drawing's rear window starts ~50 px further back (x 145) than the mesh's hatch glass (x 197), so on the mesh that strip is the body-coloured hatch panel above the spoiler - the top drawing painted it as a maroon-brown glass band; the rear/side views paint it instead

model.rebake.glass (2nd pass): polygons widened 2-3 px into Tripo's black frit - inside them a light fringe of the drawing's window colour was left as bodywork; top also gets the quarter-window panels (the top view sees their upper part, tumblehome, more squarely than the side views, so without them a light wedge stayed opaque)

model.rebake.skip rear y 1180-1209: the rear drawing's window starts higher (y 1197) than the mesh's (1212), so its dark top frame landed on the roof's rear lip as a wavy black line; the top view paints the lip alone

model.rebake.trust rear (mesh px, above the tail lights): the drawing's COBRA plate and Ford oval were dropped by the agreement test because Tripo painted that panel plain blue; here the aligned rear drawing wins
